card.name: Small words before the next noun phrase
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "the", "of", "a" or a space before a number, mostly in Akka actor documentation and in treatment-duration phrases like "at least" or "a minimum of".

card.writes: It promotes odd name-like pieces and suppresses time words such as Months and Year, so no clear output effect on the next word.
card.plain: It fires on small filler words just before a noun or a number, in software actor text and in how-long-to-treat phrases.
